design.inverse: Given a proposed typed source tree, enumerate only the finite operator signatures and component sequences permitted by the current context. Unify each observed component with an operator or typed value, reduce left to right, and emit the unique tree whose final residual has arity zero. Inversion fails on omitted arguments, duplicate participants, unconsumed components or a final result with an open type.
inverse_symmetries: Consistent renaming of opaque typed values and operator surface components.
Permutation among equivalent ordinary-water values when the source scope does not distinguish them.
No symmetry may identify FORM1 with EFFIGY or FIRST_MEDIUM with SECOND_FILL; those identities are part of the source contract.
design.observable_consequence: The same FORM1 value component has two different legal roles only through declared type: REUSE(FORM1) supplies REFILL's second argument and BREAK_SHELL's second argument, while MEDIUM_BY_STATUS consumes STATUS before MIX. A rival positional macro that treats repeated FORM as a fresh object predicts a new form at REFILL or makes BREAK_SHELL destroy the only result. A rival that applies status after the first mix predicts no status-conditioned medium.
positive_basis: Directed composition and whole-form/context residuals are retained by GDT608 and GDT282/286/318.
Cennini supplies distinct typed participants and a real identity chain: MODEL, FORM1, FIRST_MEDIUM, second fill, shell and EFFIGY.
The contract differs from OPEN/UPDATE/CLOSE tag annotation: every operator has a declared input/output type and must consume an argument.
design.reduction_law: Read a component sequence as a left-associated partial application. A component can introduce an operator, a typed argument, or a residual closure. APPLY(f,x) reduces only when x has the next declared type; the result becomes the next available argument. A closure residual is legal only when the operator's arity is filled. The current context carries MODEL, STATUS and FORM1; it may supply a declared omitted argument once, but never invents a new participant. Any unused component or type mismatch rejects the parse.
design.smallest_discriminator: A future complete passage containing a shared component in both a medium operation and an identity-preserving reference must parse with the same typed component inventory and different argument positions. The model predicts a type error for a component moved into the wrong position; a whole-form alias or untyped phase tag can still accept it, so the two outcomes are separable without knowing the English values.
design.strongest_failure: The source does not identify target component boundaries or prove that any repeated written part is an operator. If a complete exposed target passage requires the same component to have incompatible input/output types under one context, the algebra fails; adding a context-specific overloaded operator would be an ad hoc repair. The model also remains exploratory because Cennini's practical mechanics and later-cast antecedent are partly unresolved.
design.surface_contract: A reusable operator component is shared across forms; value components are shared by type. The whole-form residual chooses among the declared operators only after partial application has supplied their arguments. No residual may directly name a complete event, and no per-form alias is permitted.

positive_basis: The live structural baseline supports directed reusable parts, whole-form residuals and entry context, but does not identify meanings.
The source explicitly reuses previous sections and hours, splits long psalms, joins adjacent psalms, repeats groups at the same hours, and requires whole-week coverage.
IDEA000393 owns the broad allocation/coverage mechanism; this card changes the semantic focus to cursor/reference resolution and identity-preserving split/join operations.
design.reference_law: A long-scope reference resolves to the most recent source-declared cursor or named schedule unit of the required type. residua means the unconsumed sections of the current psalm cursor; idem and per easdem horas repeat the same identity and hour slot; sicut supra retrieves the earlier non-psalm service template. A split preserves one PSALM identity across multiple SECTION values; JOIN creates one performance unit while retaining both source PSALM identities. No nearest-word or fresh identity is allowed when the reference has a declared type.

rivals.difference: Resets the current psalm/section cursor at each day and cannot resolve residua or per easdem horas.
Treats every psalm as one indivisible performance unit and fails the explicit splits and 115+116 join.
Equates weekly identity coverage with exactly 150 utterances and cannot retain repeated daily groups.

design.smallest_discriminator: On one complete future passage, freeze whether a repeated later group refers to an earlier identity, its unconsumed remainder, or a new unit. The cursor model predicts different output for each typed reference; a local list rival predicts no cross-clause identity or split/join constraint.
design.strongest_failure: A target may have no independently bound canonical identities, section boundaries or weekly repetition. Then cursor carry can be imposed on arbitrary prose and has no force. The source schedule also invokes external psalm texts and prior office templates; this card owns chapter18's instructions, not all 150 psalm contents.
design.surface_composition_link: A future shared word grammar would need reusable components for PSALM, SECTION, HOUR and REFERENCE, with whole-form/context selecting INIT, ADVANCE, REPEAT, SPLIT or JOIN. The target consequence is a long-scope identity relation and coverage invariant, not one gloss per source word.
symmetries: global renaming of PSALM identifiers
equivalent naming of SECTION slices
permutation of ordinary hour labels only where the source does not distinguish them
design.worked_consequence: If the cursor is reset before residua, Monday lesser hours reuse Sunday sections of 118 instead of the nine unconsumed sections, violating the stated two-day exhaustion. If SPLIT creates new psalm identities, the weekly coverage count changes; if JOIN erases both identities, the explicit 115+116 construction is lost. The same source identity can therefore occupy several sections while performance units and slot references change.

complete_source_trace: Oedipus-style trace: incident messenger_arrives -> RECOGNIZE(agent,identity,agent) and REVERSE(fortune,alarm_to_relief_or_opposite); COINCIDE(reversal,recognition) -> PATHOS(pity_or_fear)
Lynceus-style rival outcome: Danaus intends_to_kill Lynceus, but the preceding incident reverses the expected result; the same action chain yields Danaus_dead and Lynceus_saved
Iphigenia example: letter reveals Iphigenia to Orestes; a second RECOGNIZE is required for Iphigenia to know Orestes, preserving one-sided versus two-sided recognition

FOLLOW.signature: INCIDENT x INCIDENT x CAUSE_LINK -> PLOT_MIDDLE

RECOGNIZE.signature: AGENT x KNOWLEDGE x AGENT -> RECOGNITION

positive_basis: GDT608 retains directed order plus whole-form residual; GDT282/286/318 retain entry/context effects. This card gives those formal observations a distinct narrative relation hypothesis.
The source explicitly requires one whole action with beginning/middle/end and says displacement of an organic incident disturbs the whole.
IDEA000127 covers syllogistic proof registers; this card is narrative event causality and two-sided recognition, not premise/conclusion logic.

rivals.difference: Stores ordered incidents without a typed causal edge or persistent knowledge state.
Treats every later event as after-the-fact and cannot distinguish a probable/necessary chain from coincidence.
Allows only one recognition direction and fails the Iphigenia/Orestes two-recognition consequence.

design.scope_law: Every FOLLOW edge points to an earlier or current incident in the same PLOT and is labelled PROBABILITY, NECESSITY or POST_HOC. REVERSE changes the fortune value of the same action; it does not introduce a new action. RECOGNIZE changes an agent's knowledge state and can be one-sided or two-sided. COINCIDE may combine the two on the same turn. END closes only after the whole action has a complete causal chain; unrelated episodic incidents cannot be silently inserted.
design.smallest_discriminator: A future complete passage must contain two linked events and a later state change. Freeze whether the later change is causal, a reversal, recognition of one or both agents, or merely adjacent. The constructor predicts different downstream result fields without knowing the English names of the agents.
design.strongest_failure: Without independently marked event boundaries, knowledge changes and causal relations, this model can describe almost any narrative after the fact. The source theory is also a general literary abstraction; it cannot independently identify manuscript genre or target word meanings.
design.surface_composition_link: A prospective shared grammar would reuse ACTION/AGENT/INCIDENT components across clauses. Whole residual and entry context would select FOLLOW, REVERSE, RECOGNIZE or END only after typed arguments are present; no terminal may encode an entire plot turn.
symmetries: renaming agents and incidents
swapping equivalent probability/necessity paraphrases where no contrast is source-owned
global reversal of opaque surface codes only after typed roles are fixed
design.worked_consequence: A list of the same incidents without a causal edge can match participants and order but cannot derive whether a later event is a reversal, a recognition, or mere post hoc adjacency. Under the constructor, coincident reversal and recognition produce a complex turn and affective consequence; a simple plot or post-hoc rival leaves the fortune and knowledge fields separate. Moving one incident can therefore change whether the complete plot remains one action.

summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. The model distinguishes causal scope from mere event adjacency and does not reuse the syllogistic proof cards.

complete_source_trace: At a seasonal quarter, select the source-declared preceding new/full Moon branch, carry it to the relevant quarter, and then apply the configuration of Moon and planets; do not merge new-Moon and full-Moon paths
When the next aspect arrives, EXPIRE(old_state) and open the next state; a local cloud or sign observation does not by itself erase the carried duration
positive_basis: The live baseline permits context carry and whole-form residuals as formal observations while denying confirmed meanings.
The source itself gives a long-scope reference rule: the atmospheric state opened by an observation continues until a later aspect, with shorter local observations at rising/setting.
This is distinct from existing zodiac-name, house-register and Vitruvius-clock cards: it tests state expiry and nested temporal scope, not a zodiac dictionary or mechanical clock.

rivals.difference: Every later observation starts a new local state and loses the aspect-bounded duration.
Day/night state lasts to a fixed clock boundary rather than the next aspect.
New/full Moon and Sun-Moon aspect branches are merged, erasing the source's separate timing paths.

design.scope_law: SUN_RISING opens a day state and SUN_SETTING opens a night state. A Sun-Moon ASPECT attaches a duration bound to the currently open state; the state remains active until the next aspect, not merely until the next written clause. A new aspect updates or expires the previous state. New/full Moon observations and planetary/sign configurations are qualifiers of the relevant state window, not free independent states.
design.smallest_discriminator: On a future complete passage with two observations before a declared aspect boundary, freeze whether the second observation inherits the first state or opens a new one. The model and nearest-observation rival produce different state counts and expiry points without requiring fixed planet-name glosses.
design.strongest_failure: Astrological weather prose may not resemble the target register, and no target independently marks aspect boundaries or state windows. Without such markers, state carry can be imposed on ordinary sequential text and has no selection force.
design.surface_composition_link: A prospective writer would reuse SUN/MOON/ASPECT/STATE components across observations. A whole residual or entry context selects OPEN, QUALIFY, UPDATE or EXPIRE after typed arguments are present; the long-scope state reference is the semantic consequence, not an arbitrary whole-word alias.
symmetries: renaming opaque state and aspect values
global rotation of sign labels when only relational aspect is used
equivalent day/night wording where source scope does not contrast them
design.worked_consequence: If two observations occur between one Sun-Moon aspect and the next, both belong to the same carried atmospheric window unless the source declares a new opening. A nearest-clause rival creates two states and predicts two independent expiries; an immediate-reset rival expires the first state at the next written observation. The source constructor predicts one shared state with one aspect-bounded expiry.

application_rules: Forward case: a written Frame immediately followed by a written RecipientRef r yields F.eval(r). In qod|aiin this is the old attraction predicate awaiting f and x; the old separate goal argument must agree with r.

Backward case: a written Frame immediately followed by NOM yields NOM(F). The result's process relation and host role are inherited from that same Frame, not selected by the spelling of the whole word.

The backward rule is identical inside a licensed compound and across a real word boundary. A standalone ar therefore needs an immediately preceding complete written Frame expression; it cannot retrieve an unspoken frame or serve as a noun by itself.

Only the three compound cuts qod|aiin, qod|ar and qok|ar are licensed here. No arbitrary substring deletion, opposite-direction fallback, silent LOC_OWNER conversion or segmentation of every ar-ending word is licensed.

source.complete_argument_summary: III.1 names alterative and attractive faculties by their activities. A part receives suitable nutriment through attraction; presentation is its goal. Adhesion precedes assimilation, which takes time. Continued departure prevents both; a resident retentive faculty is needed, under the stated purposeful-Nature premise. III.9 extends attraction of the appropriate, rejection of the foreign, and powers of retaining and altering all that is attracted to the spleen, liver, veins, arteries, heart and any nourished part; all four faculties are necessary. The proposal must eventually express this entire scope, not merely list four names.

The product and its alleged precursor must be tied by writing independently of choosing GENERATION or PREFORMED_SELECTIVE. Retyping the whole honey portion as a preformed bile constituent is not a valid witness without the required part/whole relation.

A completed account asserting an output, explicitly excluding a preformed witness for that output, and asserting its precursor/body origin defeats pure selective release for that output. Missing preformed information is not such a negation.

A completed account explicitly giving a preformed constituent, the same output lineage and NoKindChange defeats a claim of KindChange on THAT lineage. It does not defeat generation of another output or elsewhere in the case.

If a whole argument rejects P solely from D, its derivation must own U in the correct asserted or attributed scope. A merely hypothetical premise cannot silently become a narrator fact. The same graph without U must retain selective release as a countermodel.

uniformity_bridge.logical_form: Let P be the preformed-only hypothesis, U its asserted recipient-invariance bridge, and D the separately asserted outcome contrast. P AND U implies NOT(D). With D one can reject P AND U; rejecting P alone requires retaining U as an additional premise.
uniformity_bridge.not_free: No inference to D from positive bile and blood outputs alone. No inference to U from same kind alone. No inference that all honey portions have the same composition. No retrospective universal quantifier or clinical-state identity may supply these premises.
uniformity_bridge.serious_rival: Selective release rejects U while retaining preformed constituents. It is therefore not eliminated merely by the source's paired outcomes. The source author's generation assertion and this rival disagree in causal/provenance content, even where their positive outcome descriptions agree.
uniformity_bridge.what_the_author_uses: The preformed-only causal hypothesis is paired with an asserted bridge to uniform results across recipients. This bridge is extra causal content. It is not entailed by the logical definition of containment or by sharing a food-kind name.

new_formal_contract.law_preservation: INHIBITS(q,L,k) AND DEPLETES(L,R,k) AND SUPPORTS(R,F,k,g) licenses PATH(q,F,k,g,[L,R],positive). The two L and two R arguments must be identical denotations, not merely members of one word class.

new_formal_contract.path_output: PATH is an attributed explanatory relation, not an achieved event. Positive and negative paths remain two records indexed by intermediates. They are not summed, canceled, voted on or converted into a net sign.

whole_source_duties: Opening: tin in fire separates metals, including lead/brass from gold/silver, and protects other metals in hot fire. Hard brass/iron nevertheless burn and waste in strong fire without tin. The source does not give temperatures, quantities or a controlled protocol.
Tinning brazen vessels is said to reduce rust venom and improve savour; tin also tempers mirrors and makes ceruse as lead does. These are mandatory full-paragraph claims, not modern use advice.

Aristotle-attributed composition uses good quicksilver and evil brimstone, not well mixed but joined in small parts, to explain silver colour without its sadness. Preserve the historical terminology; do not equate this automatically with modern density or purity.

Hermes-attributed alchemy says tin breaks all metals/bodies mixed with it because of its dryness and destroys hammer-work obedience. This is a different operation/property relation from protection in fire, not proof that tin is simply universally beneficial or harmful.

If quicksilver is mixed therewith, the next pronouns, crassing, initial whitening and later blackening/defilement must remain. The pronoun owners and crassing are not fully resolved in this edited wording; do not invent a precise alloy reaction or use it as an independently clear timed case.
Burnt tin produces red as lead does; strong fire is said to bring back the first matter of tin. This is not a demonstrated reversible chemical process or a quantity-conservation law.

The final comparison places tin more nesh than silver and harder than lead, yet lead may not be soon soldered to lead, brass or iron without tin. Retain soon: this is qualified facilitation/necessity, not unqualified physical impossibility.

Neither may these be soldered without grease or tallow. Preserve these as anaphoric to the named soldering cases, tin as a separate aid, and grease/tallow as the stated alternatives. Do not infer success or a complete sufficient recipe merely from presence of both aid classes.

summary: RAW UNREVIEWED. Complete Steele id00105 makes tin protective in fire but destructive of hammerability when mixed, then says named lead joints cannot be soon soldered without tin and cannot be soldered without grease or tallow. The proposed account retains the two aid classes, alternative scope, qualified soon and separate operation outcomes; it does not turn requirements into a sufficient recipe.
title: RAW soldering keeps a metal aid and alternative adjuncts distinct despite operation-specific material effects

design.unit: Whole id00090, As wits and virtues are needed to the ruling of kind through others that oft lose use of reason. The entire historical physiology paragraph is mandatory within the owned chapter; not just the memory sentence.
whole_source_duties: Opening: bodily faculties require spirits for their operation; spirit is described as subtle/airy bodily substance generated through heat, not automatically the rational soul.

Physicians-attributed liver account: heat works on blood, boiling generates smoke, veins purify it into natural spirit; that spirit then makes blood subtle and moves/sends it to limbs. Preserve the mediator acting on its earlier source medium; no measured feedback law is supplied.

The same spirit travels toward the heart, is further purified through the described movement/smiting, and is called vital. Its spread to limbs and the works it governs remain distinct from a mere change of label.

Left-heart artery divides into downward and upward branches; downward supply serves lower limbs, upward divides into right arm, left arm and brain/higher parts. Retain all named branches and their recipients without assuming any corresponding manuscript picture/count.

The same spirit enters brain cavities, is further refined and changed into animal spirit, generated in the foremost cavity. Some spreads to sensation limbs; some remains for common sense/common wit/imagination. No assertion that all incoming spirit is consumed or that one indivisible parcel occupies every branch.

The account proceeds to the Logistic middle cavity for intellect/understanding; after informing intellect, it passes to memory bearing prints of likeness made in the other cavities and deposits them there. The carrier, carried representations, their provenance and storage destination are different roles.

From hindmost brain parts it passes through spinal marrow to moving sinews, for voluntary movement in lower parts. Keep this continuation as well as the memory sequence; memory deposition is not declared the terminal destination of all spirit.

Closing explicitly calls it one and the same spirit named natural/vital/animal by liver/heart/head working. This is asserted continuity across processing/naming descriptions, not unchanged chemical composition or identity of every distributed portion.

The Augustine-attributed qualification denies that this spirit is the rational soul and calls it its car/instrument. Through it the soul is joined to the body; without its service no soul act is perfectly exercised in the body. Impairment/hindrance is then linked to disrupted accord and inhibited works, with historical mental-disorder examples. Preserve attribution and perfectly; no modern diagnosis or universal medical fact is established.

whole_source_duties: Opening characterizes sight as most simple and fiery and able to apprehend far things suddenly. Preserve this historical characterization rather than replacing it by modern optics.

A pure clear humour is located in the middle/black of the eye, called crystalloid by philosophers because it receives various colour forms like crystal; sight concerns colours, figures, shapes and outward properties.

The list of requirements for perfect sight names efficient cause, a suitable eye organ, air bringing likeness to the eye, attention and easy movement. Mere listing does not supply their distinct causal/instrumental/mediating roles.

Efficient cause is the animal faculty. The crystal-like humour in each eye is clear and round: clarity is connected to the text's beshine wording concerning spirit and air; roundness to resistance to injury. The precise beshine direction is uncertain and must not be silently modernized into one optical emission theory.

Air is the external assisting means without which sight cannot be perfect. This is necessity for perfect sight, not a claim that air alone guarantees it or that all imperfect sight is impossible without it.
When the soul is occupied with other matters, sight is less perfect because it does not judge the seen thing. Do not convert less perfect into necessarily no sensation or all-or-nothing blindness.

Too-swift continuous movement of the seen thing disturbs sight. Preserve the ensuing oar-appearing-broken example and its attributed swift-water explanation, even though later optics would distinguish refraction; do not repair this source account.
Direct sight: the likeness from the seen thing reaches sight along straight lines.
Reflected sight: the likeness goes from the thing to a shewer and is bent/rebounded from that surface to sight. The reflecting intermediate is neither the eye nor the original thing.

The third route is stretched between seen thing and sight but not bent and rebounded in the reflected-route sense; it can depart sideways from straightness when intervening spaces differ in clearness and thickness. Retain that wording and distinction; no Snell law, angles or modern numerical refractive index is provided.

design.contrast: A narrow obligatory concept such as WINTER or WATER in every use; a compressed construction that obligatorily contains that same concept; an inflectional family whose every licensed form retains it; and a multivalent or parameterized construction where only an explicitly qualified subset carries it. These are distinct claims, not interchangeable explanations after counting.

NO_SOURCE_SEPARATION: named concept footprints overlap sufficiently that no useful demand contrast arises; retain all semantic candidates.
NO_UNIT_OR_GENRE_BRIDGE: useful complete-source descriptions may exist, but no target constraint follows. Do not turn source availability into semantic evidence.

encoding_rivals.consequence: The bound states the minimum share of form-bearing units that would need to be concept-free under a given q. encoding_rivals.contract: The same written form may have several senses or a typed argument that changes its content. Before comparison, disclose either fixed conditioning rules or a finite permitted unit-level escape budget. Unrestricted per-occurrence choices are retained as a non-discriminating rival rather than rejected.

definitions: For one fixed complete-unit population U, A is the set of units containing at least one exact occurrence of the prospectively nominated form or finite family.
C is the set of units that express the nominated semantic concept under the registered explicit/scope convention, independently of spelling or number of groups.
p = |A|/|U|. An obligatory-C interpretation requires A to be a subset of C, so the required concept incidence is at least p.
If a separately justified bridge stipulates |C|/|U| <= q, then |A outside C|/|A| >= max(0, 1 - q/p), for p>0. This is a deterministic conditional bound, not a posterior probability.
The bound concerns form-bearing units without C. It is not the proportion of all form tokens having another sense; uneven token counts per unit prevent that conversion.
logical_core.interval_rule: Uncertain annotation, reader disagreement and incomplete source boundaries remain explicit intervals or missing capacity. design.mechanism: Use semantic presence in complete discourse units rather than equality of source-word and Voynich-group counts. A universally concept-bearing form implies unit-level concept presence. Inflection, internal abbreviation and packing do not remove that implication when each use still carries the concept. A finite multivalent interpretation instead owes an explicit account of the units where the form has another meaning. This exposes the semantic demand of a gloss without assuming that one Voynich group equals one plaintext word.
paid_assumptions: At least one registered unit/genre bridge is substantively plausible for the manuscript. A source paragraph is not automatically a Voynich paragraph, and physical leaves are not equal-content units.

Obligatory-C occurrences contribute C inside their own unit; references to a remote heading, inherited topic, copied exemplars, decorative/null writing or long-range abbreviation require separate scope rules.
Semantic annotations are complete enough to distinguish expressed concept presence from source-language surface counts. Source translations, register and genre can change what is explicit.
A hypothesized finite family has its declared shared meaning; formal composability alone does not supply that meaning or family identity.
Any bound q or mixture/coarsening range is justified and fixed before seeing the comparison, rather than defined as the observed source maximum and called a universal law.

design.question: Can one written binary predicate and one written polarity rule preserve both denied same-kind cases and both affirmed crossed cases, while retaining the source attribution and authorial uncertainty, rather than treating reciprocal pairs alone as evidence?
rivals_and_nonidentifiability: Swap A and B: exactly the same four-cell pattern. Lead versus tin cannot be identified by this table.

DIFFERENT, XOR on two categories, permitted cross-kind pairing, marriage/compatibility conventions or other symmetric irreflexive relations can share the table. A full source argument and independent meaning binding would be needed to identify SOLDER.
Reverse marked/unmarked polarity while complementing the predicate: an equality-like table can reproduce the surface contrast. The unmarked-positive convention is paid, not recovered by the pattern.
A bare scalar strict comparison fails both crossed affirmations on the same axis; changing axis or time between cells is a different model and requires written scope.
A reciprocal transport description can share AB/BA, but does not by itself assert the two diagonal prohibitions or the material hardening/authorial-knowledge clauses.
Independent lexical statements may express the same source facts. Successful full authoring does not itself establish productive morphology or historical source identity.
SOLDER_WITH(x,aid) versus JOIN_TWO_PIECES(x,y): the four-cell table alone does not choose the physical roles of WITH. A later whole account cannot silently change between these readings.

source_evidence.quote: There are two species of heliotropium, the tricoccum [note 2598] and the helioscopium, [note 2599] the latter being the taller of the two, though they neither of them exceed half [note 2600] a foot in height. The helioscopium throws out branches from the root, and the seed of it, enclosed in follicules, [note 2601] is gathered at harvest-time. It grows nowhere but in a rich soil, a highly-cultivated one more particularly; the tricoccum, on the other hand, is to be found growing everywhere. I find it stated, that the helioscopium, boiled, is considered an agreeable food, and that taken in milk, it is gently laxative [note 2602] to the bowels; while, again, a decoction of it, taken as a potion, acts as a most effectual purgative. The [page 414] juice of this plant is collected in summer, at the sixth [note 2603] hour of the day; it is usually mixed with wine, which makes [note 2604] it keep all the better. Combined with rose-oil, it alleviates head-ache. The juice extracted from the leaves, combined with salt, removes warts; from which circumstance our people have given this plant the name of “verrucaria,” [note 2605] although, from its various properties, it fully merits a better name. For, taken in wine or hydromel, it is an antidote to the venom of serpents and scorpions, [note 2606] as Apollophanes and Apollodorus state. The leaves, too, employed topically, are a cure for the cerebral affections of infants, known as “siriasis,” [note 2607] as also for convulsions, even when they are epileptic. It is very wholesome, too, to gargle the mouth with a decoction of this plant. Taken in drink, it expels tapeworm and gravel, and, with the addition of cummin, it will disperse calculi. A decoction of the plant with the root, mixed with the leaves and some suet of a he-goat, is applied topically for the cure of gout.

source_evidence.quote: The other kind, which we have spoken [note 2608] of as being called the “tricoccum,” and which also bears the name of “scorpiuron,” [note 2609] has leaves that are not only smaller than those of the other kind, but droop downwards towards the ground: the seed of it resembles a scorpion’s tail, to which, in fact, it owes its latter appellation. It is of great efficacy for injuries received from all kinds of venomous insects and the spider known as the “phalangium,” but more particularly for the stings of scorpions, if applied topically. [note 2610] Those who carry it about their person are never stung by a scorpion, and it is said that if a circle is traced on the ground around a scorpion with a sprig of this plant, the animal will never move out of it, and that if a scorpion is covered with it, or even sprinkled with the water in which it has been steeped, it will die that instant. Four [page 415] grains of the seed, taken in drink, are said to be a cure for the quartan fever, and three for the tertian; a similar effect being produced by carrying the plant three times round the patient, and then laying it under his head. The seed, too, acts as an aphrodisiac, and, applied with honey, it disperses inflamed tumours. This kind of heliotropium, as well as the other, extracts warts radically, [note 2611] and excrescences of the anus. Applied topically, the seed draws off corrupt blood from the vertebræ and loins; and a similar effect is produced by taking a decoction of it in chicken broth, or with beet and lentils. The husks [note 2612] of the seed restore the natural colour to lividities of the skin. According to the Magi, the patient himself should make four knots in the heliotropium for a quartan, and three for a tertian fever, at the same time offering a prayer that he may recover to untie them, the plant being left in the ground meanwhile.

source_evidence.quote:
## II.164, Kyklaminos — complete critical entry

### Section 1

164 κυκλάμινος· φύλλα ἔχει ὅμοια κισσῷ, ποικίλα δὲ κάτωθεν καὶ ἄνωθεν κηλῖσιν ὑπολεύκοις, καυλὸν δὲ τετραδάκτυλον, γυμνόν, ἐφ οὖ ἄνθη ῥοδοειδῆ, πορφυρίζοντα, ῥίζαν μέλαιναν, γογγυλίδι παραπλησίαν, ὑπόπλατυν, ἥτις ποθεῖσα μεθ᾿ ὑδρομέλιτος ἄγει φλέγμα καὶ ὕδωρ κάτω, καὶ ἔμμηνα δὲ κινεῖ πινομένη καὶ προστιθεμένη. φασὶ δὲ ὅτι, κἂν ὑπερβῇ τὴν ῥίζαν ἐγκύμων γυνή, ἐξαμβλώσκειν αὐτήν· ἔστι δὲ καὶ ὠκυτόκιον περιαπτομένη. πίνεται δὲ πρὸς τὰ θανάσιμα μετ᾿ οἴνου, καὶ μάλιστα πρὸς λαγωὸν θαλάσσιον, καὶ ἑρπετῶν ἐστιν ἀντιφάρμακον καταπλασσομένη, μεθύσκει τε οἴνῳ μειχθεῖσα.

### Section 2

ἀποκαθίστησι δὲ καὶ ἴκτερον τριῶν δραχμῶν πλῆθος ποθεῖσα 2 μετὰ γλυκέος ἢ μελικράτου ὑδαροῦς — κατακλίνειν δὲ δεῖ τὸν πίνοντα ἐν οἴκῳ θερμῷ καὶ πλείοσιν ἱματίοις περιβάλλειν, ὅπως ἱδρώσῃ· δ δὲ ἀποκρινόμενος ἱδρὼς χολώδης εὑρίσκεται τῇ χρόᾳ — ἐγχυματίζεταί τε ὁ χυλὸς αὐτῆς μετὰ μέλιτος εἰς τὰς ῥῖνας πρὸς κάθαρσιν κεφαλῆς, καὶ τῷ δακτυλίῳ ἐν ἐρίῳ προστίθεται πρὸς κομιδὴν περιττωμάτων. καταχρισθέντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπ᾿ ὀμφαλοῦ καὶ ὑπογαστρίου καὶ ἰσχίου κοιλίαν μαλάσσει καὶ ἐκτρρσμοὺς ἐργάζεται, καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ὑποκεχυμένους καὶ ἀμβλυωποῦντας ἐγχριόμενος ὁ χυλὸς σὺν μέλιτι ἁρμόζει· μείγνυται καὶ εἰς τὰ φθόρια, ἕδραν τε προπεσοῦσαν σὺν ὄξει καταχριόμενος ὁ χυλὸς καθίστησι.

### Section 3

χυλίζεται δὲ ἡ ῥίζα κοπτομένη καὶ ἐκθλιβομένη, 3 ἑψομένου τοῦ χυλοῦ ἄχρι μελιτώδους συστάσεως. ῥύπτει δὲ καὶ χρῶτα ἡ ῥίζα καὶ ἐξανθήματα στέλλει, καὶ τραύματα μετ᾿ ὄξους καὶ καθ᾿ ἑαυτὴν καὶ μετὰ μέλιτος ἰᾶται. καταπλασσομένη δὲ καὶ σπλῆνα τήκει, ἀποκαθαίρει δὲ καὶ ἔφηλιν καὶ ἀλωπεκίας, εὐθετεῖ δὲ καὶ πρὸς στρέμματα καὶ ποδάγραν. τὸ δὲ ἀφέψημα αὐτῆς ποιεῖ πρὸς τὰ ἐν τῇ κεφαλῇ ἑλκύδρια καὶ χιμέτλας καταντλούμενον, αὐτή τε δἰ ἐλαίου παλαιοῦ ἀναζεσθεῖσα καταχριομένου τοῦ ἐλαίου.

### Section 4

4 ἐγκοιλανθεῖσα δὲ πληροῦται τοῦ ἐλαίου καὶ τίθεται ἐπὶ θερμοσποδιᾶς, προσεμβάλλεται δὲ ἐνίοτε καὶ κηροῦ Τυρρηνικοῦ ὀλίγον, ὡς γλοιῶδες γενέσθαι, κατάχρισμα ἄριστον χιμετλιῶσιν. ἀποτίθεται δὲ ἡ ῥίζα τμηθεῖσα ὥσπερ σκίλλα. ἱστορεῖται δὲ καὶ πρὸς φίλτρα αὐτὴν λαμβάνεσθαι καεῖσαν ἀναπλασθεἰσάν τε εἰς τροχίσκους, φύεται δὲ ἐν συσκίοις τόποις, μάλιστα δὲ ὑπὸ τὰ δένδρα.

CHAPTER XII
WHITE LEAD, VERDIGRIS, AND ARTIFICIAL SANDARACH
1. It is now in place to describe the preparation of white lead and of
verdigris, which with us is called "aeruca." In Rhodes they put shavings
in jars, pour vinegar over them, and lay pieces of lead on the shavings;
then they cover the jars with lids to prevent evaporation. After a
definite time they open them, and find that the pieces of lead have
become white lead. In the same way they put in plates of copper and make
verdigris, which is called "aeruca."
2. White lead on being heated in an oven changes its colour on the fire,
and becomes sandarach. This was discovered as the result of an
accidental fire. It is much more serviceable than the natural sandarach
dug up in mines.

CHAPTER VIII
CINNABAR AND QUICKSILVER
1. I shall now proceed to explain the nature of cinnabar. It is said
that it was first found in the Cilbian country belonging to Ephesus, and
both it and its properties are certainly very strange. First, before
getting to the vermilion itself by methods of treatment, they dig out
what is called the clod, an ore like iron, but rather of a reddish
colour and covered with a red dust. During the digging it sheds, under
the blows of the tools, tear after tear of quicksilver, which is at once
gathered up by the diggers.
2. When these clods have been collected, they are so full of moisture
that they are thrown into an oven in the laboratory to dry, and the
fumes that are sent up from them by the heat of the fire settle down on
the floor of the oven, and are found to be quicksilver. When the clods
are taken out, the drops which remain are so small that they cannot be
gathered up, but they are swept into a vessel of water, and there they
run together and combine into one. Four pints of it, when measured and
weighed, will be found to be one hundred pounds.
3. If the quicksilver is poured into a vessel, and a stone weighing one
hundred pounds is laid upon it, the stone swims on the surface, and
cannot depress the liquid, nor break through, nor separate it. If we
remove the hundred pound weight, and put on a scruple of gold, it will
not swim, but will sink to the bottom of its own accord. Hence, it is
undeniable that the gravity of a substance depends not on the amount of
its weight, but on its nature.
4. Quicksilver is a useful thing for many purposes. For instance,
neither silver nor copper can be gilded properly without it. And when
gold has been woven into a garment, and the garment becomes worn out
with age so that it is no longer respectable to use, the pieces of cloth
are put into earthen pots, and burned up over a fire. The ashes are then
thrown into water and[216] quicksilver added thereto. This attracts all the
bits of gold, and makes them combine with itself. The water is then
poured off, and the rest emptied into a cloth and squeezed in the hands,
whereupon the quicksilver, being a liquid, escapes through the loose
texture of the cloth, but the gold, which has been brought together by
the squeezing, is found inside in a pure state.
